brief_rationale: All eight responsibility-chain items are met with appropriate screening, framing, reconciliation, and teach-back across a prolonged, well-documented trajectory. Five dimensions are at least good. HO4 is complete: the family's misconception that '可疑' means either confirmed or harmless was corrected with behavioral impact (continuing anticoagulation and monitoring). HO2 is complete: a detailed bedside communication script was provided with prioritized questions for nurses vs. doctors, document handling, and fallback plans. Two complete high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact justify grade 5.
